reviews.author: LINDA RYNDERS
reviews.text: Dropped off Honda Accord for AC issues on a hot holiday weekend. Great service and reasonable pricing. It was there for 2 days and went behind timing to get the issue resolved quick. Thank you to Brittney and Thomas for fixing the AC issue and great customer service.

reviews.author: Shaun Briggs
reviews.text: Everything went great! My car got towed there Monday evening and pick it up Thursday afternoon. I had a water pump, thermostat and belt replaced on a 18 Charger 5.7. I will be giving them some more business in the future. Thanks Brittney!

reviews.author: Amy Butler
reviews.text: Outstanding car care and customer service! I travel for work and the miles add up. I broke down on a business trip and barely made it home. I needed a reliable mechanic, fast! A quick Google search led me to Cox Auto and the reviews impressed me. Rightly so! From the first call, through the service, I was treated like a new friend. Brittney took time to explain details, and Thomas examined the car thoroughly and repaired it quickly. No high pressure sales, just solid information. My car runs great! This family owned business renewed my confidence in car repairs. No more auto shop anxiety! Thank you, Cox Auto! Please check them out- they earned these reviews! You'll be thankful too!

reviews.author: Nikki Kemp
reviews.text: I just happened to find this wonderful place! I had spent months with other mechanics with trial and error for a year. They found the issue fixed my car good as new, and even made sure I had transportation while they repaired my baby. They were fast and very fair on pricing! This team is awesome and will be my mechanic from this point on! I cannot say thank you enough!

reviews.author: lorraine mccarthy
reviews.text: I was so blessed to be initially referred to them by my coworker. My car failed the state inspection due to lower control arms, and I needed it up to par as soon as possible. Their prices are reasonable and comparable to other Auto services. I was impressed with the professionalism. He was able to give me a detailed quote of the services he would provide. I chose to fix both lower control arms, alignment, and tag light. It has been over 2 months that my car has been repaired and it's still working excellently. What stands out to me the most is 1. There was a loaner car provided so that I could still go to work while my car was being serviced. No other Auto service I reached out to offered that. 2. The mechanic noticed my left side mirror was hanging by a thread and replaced it at no additional charge. 3. When I went to pick up my car I noticed there was a new state inspection sticker in the window. The mechanic took my car to be re-inspected. In this way, I did not have to go and get another state inspection. In everyway, I fully recommend that you use Cox Auto services for your car maintenance needs.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.text: I am from out of town and was stranded one night. I took a chance on a random Google search and now I have repair shop for life when im near VA. Thomas and his wife have helped me out with car troubles multiple times now. This shop always goes over and above what im normally used to dealing with repair shops. I appreciate all you have done for my Camaro see you on the next issue. Hopefully not too soon :)

reviews.author: Melissa De León
reviews.text: My car had a steering wheel problem. I decided to take it with him because of the good reviews he has and I’m so happy with the service. Since I contacted him until I picked my car back he was very nice, honest and very helpful. He is a very knowledgeable mechanic and most important, he’s such a reliable one. If you’re looking for a good mechanic bring it with him you’ll get a quality service advisor for a good price.

reviews.author: Shelby Vincent
reviews.text: Was in a time bind when my starter went out on my truck. Thomas came towed it and fixed it in less than 24hrs while still doing a check on everything because I had mentioned we were leaving for the beach in three days. Ended up doing my belts, breaks, roaters on top of the initial issue the starter! IN LESS THAN 24 HOURS!!! 10/10 recommend!!

reviews.author: Barbara Parham
reviews.text: The professionalism and the service was remarkable! His wife saw my car on a trailer in a parking lot and knew that her husband could help me and they spoke on it and within 20 minutes I was in the shop. Mind you, it was after hours around 7:30 PM so I know he was tired and ready to go home. But he drove all the way back to the shop just to help me and I am forever grateful! They are a dynamic duo. He had tools that the shop that just sent me home today ACE Body shop, they didn’t even have and even after ordering a set of tools for the tire job. They ordered the wrong set and told me it was nothing they could do. I have officially found my new auto mechanic in the Tri-City area Of Virginia. I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lindsey Barker
reviews.text: it was almost 10 or 11pm at night when i was going down 295 highway. just a mile away from the exit my tire popped & i almost spun out. not knowing what to do, all it took was one phone call to ‘Cox Auto Service’!they reassured me it was okay & without hesitation or any complaints Brittney & Thomas were on the way arriving within 30 minutes to help fix my situation. i am beyond blessed & thankful for the fast, reliable & overall amazing service provided per usual (especially at the time of night) i highly recommend Cox Auto Service for any maintenance/ troubles you may have with your vehicle or even if you need a tow! this was not the first time they’ve helped me when in a bind or fixed something that’s broken. each & every time it’s reliable, quick & all issues resolved; thank you both again i couldn’t be more thankful to have such reliable, trusting, & professional services !

reviews.author: Stefanie D Davis
reviews.text: This is my second time with Cox automotive. They really came in clutch right before christmas for me and my family. They even picked me up at my house to get my car since it was my only transportation. His wife was super sweet with me and a great listener. Highly recommend this company. They are trustworthy and reliable. Affordable and knowledgeable. 10/10

reviews.author: Larry Owens
reviews.text: Got 2 loose steering knuckle bolts taken care of on a Saturday. Quick and affordable friendly service. Couldn't find a better shop if you tried.

reviews.author: Brittney
reviews.text: Cox Auto completed a tremendous amount of work on my 2014 Nissan Altima. The work was done in a timely manner, very proficient, and reasonables prices for all of it. I highly reccommend this company to everyone looking for car services. Thanks again Cox Auto for a job well done!

reviews.author: Becky Tran
reviews.text: AMAZING service and wonderful people! I was traveling through the area and my car started to rattle very badly going over simple bumps on the road. It was late but Cox Auto Service was able to squeeze me in last minute. They quickly diagnosed and resolved the issue in less than 20 mins. I HIGHLY recommend them. If I lived in the area, this is the only mechanic shop I would go to. They were very courteous and professional with their work, 10/10!

reviews.author: jim mills
reviews.text: When my wife and I were driving back to our Florida home on the Saturday after Thanksgiving 2025, the alternator light came on in our Honda Pilot. We found an auto parts store in Colonial Heights who confirmed that our alternator was bad and had to be replaced. So we bought the part and tried to find a repair shop at 4PM that day to install it. After many rejections, we came upon Cox Auto Repair. Brittany and Thomas were Lifesavers! Not only did they repair the car that night, they didn't price gouge us. We highly recommend them and if we lived anywhere in the Colonial Heights area, this would be the only auto repair shop we would ever use!

reviews.author: strat wallace
reviews.text: Amazing place, great service, nice people. They responded quickly, provided a quick and fair estimate for the repair, located the part, and serviced the vehicle that included a tow and a loaner. Brittney was friendly, resourceful, and easy to communicate with on the phone. Tommy explained the job and got the work done in timely manner, getting us back on the road. Because of the high quality of service, and the reasonable fee, I would use again and highly recommend to anyone. Many thanks to Cox Auto Service!

reviews.author: Felicia Mitchell
reviews.text: One word- Awesome! This is the second engine (2different cars) Cox Auto has installed for me. Efficient, less expensive, and caring! Brittany arranged everything! They picked up the vehicle, returned the core, test drove it multiple times to ensure all was running as it should. Thomas not only repairs but also educates you! COX AUTO IS MY FIRST CALL! It should be yours too! Thanks Thomas and Brittany! You rock!!!

reviews.author: Rosemarie May
reviews.text: Thank goodness that I was referred to them to repair my air conditioner in my RAV4. I initially went to another garage who quoted me a price that was out of my price range and said it would take a week to complete the replacement. The folks at Cox repaired it in a couple of days and even provided me with a loaner car. I'm so grateful for their kindness and professionalism

reviews.author: Justin Baker
reviews.text: I just want to thank Cox auto service for repairing my vehicle in a timely fashion. They do amazing work and I will be returning to them with all my car needs from now on. They had my vehicle ready within a day of drop off and I’m extremely grateful for that. I appreciate them so much. Thank you Cox auto service!!! I will be seeing you again real soon.

reviews.author: Ivan Lopez
reviews.text: I was relocating to Texas and had 2 vehicles in my backyard that I needed moved. Cox Auto Service came out teed the vehicles to a friends house for a reasonable rate. There was some confusion on one of the vehicles and needed it removed. Cox came out picked up the vehicle and hauled it away the same day in a severe thunderstorm. Thank Thomas and Brittney. Really came through with excellent and speedy service. I would recommend using this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Sadajuia Pimble
reviews.text: Love this place already! They’re truly fast and affordable, and I would definitely recommend this shop to others [in a heartbeat]. Please don’t hesitate to give them a call!

reviews.author: Kail Johnson
reviews.text: They got me in on a Saturday and back out within a couple of hours. Highly recommend this shop. Will be back whenever I run into anymore car issues

reviews.author: Whitney Barringer
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Cox Auto Service has repaired my car twice now. Thomas and Brittney are fast, reliable, and knowledgeable. Great customer service and communication. Very fair prices too!

reviews.author: Sherrie Boyd
reviews.text: He put my water pump on after some one started tje job and didnt finish it.he put back together what some one else took apart and didnt charge a arm or leg.he was very fast at doing the work

reviews.author: Louis Conner
reviews.text: I highly recommend Cox Auto Service, Thomas is knowledgeable, honest and reliable. When my truck started to sound like a racecar, I called Cox Auto Friday morning. By Friday afternoon they had come to the house, diagnosed an exhaust manifold problem and took my truck to his shop. Thomas was able to repair, the manifold and my truck was ready to hit the road the next day(a Saturday) completely back to it's old self. The pricing was fair and you can trust you won't be nickel and dimed or sold unnecessary work. Cox Automotive is definitely my go-to for all of my family's automotive needs!

reviews.author: Ruby Million
reviews.text: Thank God a friend told me about Cox Auto Service! Otherwise I would’ve had to park my truck. There’s no way I could afford dealership prices. He was willing to replace the heater core in my truck and other mechanics wouldn’t call back once they heard about the problem. Great mechanic and very knowledgeable and affordable!

reviews.author: Angry Artist
reviews.text: Have had multiple vehicles repaired by Cox auto. They are very professional and the prices on repairs are the best around. Quick turnaround and even comes to you if needed to inspect the vehicle. Definitely a mechanic you can trust. Definitely has a lifelong customer.

reviews.author: Clarence Johnson
reviews.text: Had a great experience. Cox provides towing, great prices, great work and was really fast at getting my car back on the road. Definitely going back and recommend everyone checking them out.

reviews.author: Eric Henry
reviews.text: I recently had my valve cover gasket, brakes, and a brake fluid exchange done on my Accord at Cox Automotive, and as always, Tommy did a fantastic job. I’ve been bringing my car to him for over three years now, and his attention to detail and expertise are unmatched. Every time, My car always runs smoothly afterward, and I have complete confidence in his recommendations. Highly recommend Cox Automotive for honest, reliable, and skilled service!”

reviews.author: Tracy Wood
reviews.text: Thomas has worked on my Toyota numerous times!!! I won’t let anyone else touch it. Today he replaced the hood on my 2000 Camry and she looks beautiful. Thomas is very knowledgeable, fair and very easy to work with. Take your vehicles to Cox Auto Service, I promise you, you will be very happy you did. Thanks again, Thomas

reviews.author: Jordan Privett
reviews.text: I had some pretty major repairs done all under warranty, I’m a bit nervous about long term condition of my my engine after all the repair but I trust that the mechanic here will keep in touch and help me stay on top of the maintenance of my car.

reviews.author: Amber Moneymaker
reviews.text: As someone who has had my fair share of mechanics… I have to say this has been 100% the most pleasurable experience of them all. I contacted Cox auto service and was immediately Greeted by human being.. Not a automatic service… I was able to explain my issue and have my car picked up within a timely manner.. Every step of the way they kept in touch with me to let me know what they were working on in any issues they found… They were very accommodating on time which they were able to bring me my car and made sure I was there first priority… I haven’t had an issue with my car since… I highly suggest this company if you would like honest good hearted people to make sure you and your family are safe on the road

reviews.author: Yvonka Weaver
reviews.text: I am new to this area. I have been having a more than difficult time finding someone to actually work on my vehicle. More people than enough told me they didn’t want to do the repairs because the vehicle is “too old”. When I dropped my vehicle at this repair shop I told them the brakes went out. When they called me back it was such a detailed explanation I started asking questions. Now I’m not naive to navigating a vehicle. My dad was a drag racer, so I grew up in the pit. I’m just at the age where I’m not gonna work on a vehicle. So then we come to a price. I’m like REALLY because everywhere else I had gone to gave me a quote of $2500+ on top of telling me they wouldn’t do the work. This guy was fair and honest. He also told me everything else that was wrong with the truck. He did the engine diagnostics and I didn’t even ask about that. So YEP - I’m a customer for life! This guy just gives off a real good vibe. He not trying to bang your head in. He not doing a half ass job. Just a good honest man trying to make an honest living for him and his family - nothing but respect for those type folk.

reviews.author: Sue Konwisarz
reviews.text: So my son has a 2016 Chevy Camaro. We had nothing but troubles with this car from the start the engine went on it. We finally found a new engine, but we couldn’t find anyone to put the engine in the car until someone recommended Cox Auto. And let me tell you They did such a great job in such a short time very professional, reasonable, knowledgeable, Reliable. Very impressed I was and though I never met Thomas He did an amazing job the car runs like brand new again. I had the pleasure of speaking to and meeting his wife, Brittany, who is very professional, very sweet always attentive. Whenever I called, texted or had a question. She was right there always answering me. Thank you. So if someone asked me, do you know a mechanic…. I would definitely absolutely positively recommend Cox Auto. So thanks again and my son got his car back just in time for his 18th birthday:) So he also is thrilled and says Thank you.

reviews.author: Stephen O'Donnell
reviews.text: These owners are customer service providers. Will definitely use Cox Auto Service again. Amazing attention to detail. Their mobile service is where it's at. Showed up, diagnosed the problem and after getting the part, out the door, no hassle. Truly appreciate fantastic people running a stellar small business. Going to pass out their business cards to everyone at work. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Marie Mitchell
reviews.text: Cox Auto has reasonable prices. Customer service is of superior quality. Very friendly and extremely respectable. He is my mechanic from now on. Let me know if you’re looking for a GREAT mechanic. I highly recommend him.

reviews.text: Brittany and her husband are wonderful, they have made something that was difficult into an pleasant experience . I have an 2019 vw atlas and it needed an water pump, not only where they able to fix it but they fix it within a day. I'm truly blessed for finding people that are reasonable and down to earth. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Jordan Sanderson
reviews.text: Thomas, was very fair and honest with my project. He explained why I was having issues with our Jeep Wrangler, he explained how it happened and the steps to fix it. He offered a loaner vehicle and worked with my very tight schedule. He got the job done and it’s been great since. Thanks highly recommend, lots of experience and knowledge here has! Thanks again A+

reviews.author: Michele Zimmerman
reviews.text: Have nothing but wonderful things to say about Cox Auto Services! They are absolutely everything you are looking for when it comes to great, honest and affordable work with any of your vehicle needs. I stand by their work and the way they handle their business. I definitely encourage you to give them a call the next time you are in need of any car needs! Thank you Cox Auto Service for all you do and continue to do for us needing car repairs!

reviews.author: Stephanie McKee
reviews.text: Cox Auto Service....they are kind, courteous, and honest. If it needs to be done then they will tell you. If it can wait a bit, they will tell you. They work on our 2012 Explorer and 2017 Honda Accord. I highly recommend for your automotive repair needs.

reviews.author: Mindy Regal
reviews.text: This business was recommended to me by a friend. I contacted them and Thomas came to my home and fixed my car. He was very polite and reasonably priced. Excellent customer service. Definitely will use them in the future and will recommend to anyone!

reviews.text: Would definitely recommend this company a1 work .. they took there time and didnt skimp on work very reasonable with price and great people!

reviews.text: My 2014 Ford Taurus had very bad coolant leak. Cox Auto Service was very professional in every manner. They took my car in without hesitation, as well as giving me updates (ie.) when my parts were coming in and when it will be available for pick up. 10 out of 10 highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Rufus Harris
reviews.text: Cox's auto service is an outstanding service center, our 2016 caddillac ct6 a/c stop working. Caddillac dealership wanted to schedule me a month out, however, Cox auto center got me in, the price and repairs were great. The car run and cool great. This is an outstanding auto service center, it's the only repair shop we use for all of our caddillac brands. Thanks alot Cox for your outstanding services.

reviews.author: Valerie Ford
reviews.text: This guy right here can do anything but cosmetic repair to anything with an engine. For YEARS, I have consistently brought Tommy more headaches (than he cares to relive) with my love of older vehicles but he shows up Every time. Every. Single. Time. He's worked on my 95 Suzuki sidekick, 2006 jeep commander, and brought back to life an older mini cooper that sat for 2 years with out any issues or complaints ( unless it's him- offering to push my whips down a boat ramp free of charge). He's trustworthy, fairly priced, hardworking, determined, and I guarantee will get you back on the road if you give him a chance. Don't waste your money on dealerships or commercial shops- you'll wind up bringing it to Tommy so he can fix whatever it was they messed up anyways. Give Cox auto a call. You will have 0 regrets. - did I mention he has loner cars available while he works on your vehicle?

reviews.text: Always pleased with repairs. Never a problem. Highly recommend. Thomas and Brittany are the best. They go above and beyond. Prices are always fair. I know when I ask Thomas to fix one of my vehicles I don't have to worry ,it's done right and Thomas stands behind his work. Thank you both.

Their prices are reasonable, their turnaround time is excellent, and most importantly, they are honest and trustworthy. I highly recommend this shop and will definitely return for any future repairs!
